JARA TAFSEEER SE BATAYE Narrated with sound chains from Dhu Mikhbar al-Najashi: " You will make a firm truce with the Romans (al-Rum) until you and they wage a campaign against an enemy that is attacking them. You will be granted victory and great spoils. Then you will alight in a plain surrounded by hills. There, someone among the Romans shall say: 'The Cross has overcome!' whereupon someone among the Muslims shall say: 'Nay, Allah has overcome!' and shall go and break the cross. The Romans shall kill him, then the Muslims shall take up their arms and the two sides shall fall upon each other. Allah shall grant martyrdom to that group of Muslims. After that the Romans shall say to their leader: 'We shall relieve you of the Arabs,' and they shall gather up for the great battle. They shall come to you under eighty flags (nations), each flag (nation) gathering 12,000 troops." (Abu Dawud, Kitab al-Jihad - Vol. 3/7 - No. 2479, Ahmad, Ibn Majah) 2788 views Q. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 43451 Country: India Title: preaching Question: I have a strong will (niyah) to keep beard but I have a fear that will I be successful to keep it for always. How much big sin is not to keep beard? I am afraid, lest in future, I remove my beard. Please guide me what should I do? If a person who does not keep beard, will Allah not accept his good deeds, salah, zakah, Hajj and any other small ibadah? Should we wait till my iman be stronger for this? Please reply me as soon as possible. I am in confusion. Answer ID: 43451 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 185/315/N=1434) This hadith is mentioned in Bukhari as well as Muslim (Mishkah, p. 33). It means one should maintain the interest of the people while preaching i.e. it should not be too long to get people bored, rather it should be as long as people are interested. But the system of tablighi Jamah is like a complete syllabus and in order to gain from any syllabus it is necessary that all its terms and conditions are fulfilled. If a student of any madrasa attends some classes and misses some then he cannot succeed and cannot benefit from the course. Likewise, until you are not attached to all the activities of the tablighi Jamah you cannot benefit from it fully. The reason you get bored is that till now you are not completely aware of the importance and need of tablighi Jamah. Hence you should try to understand its importance and necessity. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
